answer_1.quote: In this work, we present the first investigation into improving the aesthetic quality of text generated by LLMs.
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on enhancing the aesthetic quality of text generated by LLMs, including aspects such as clarity, layout, uniformity, and coherence.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the aesthetic quality of texts generated by LLMs using two methods: text-based and image-based text aesthetics scoring.

answer_3.quote: Consequently, we employ the "LLM-as-a-judge" framework to approximate human preferences for text aesthetics.

answer_4.quote: To further validate the models' performance, we conducted a human evaluation to further validate the models' performance.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were introduced to the four evaluation dimensions—clarity (ease of comprehension), layout (visual organization), uniformity (consistent formatting), and coherence (logical structure)—with detailed explanations and examples.
